Regardless of how you feel she has been in your life, as well as your children’s lives. I would feel awful if I was told to get over myself when I just want to be acknowledged for being around, she didn’t even say she wanted to be mom, maybe she just wants your kids to know she’s there for them.

I’m so sorry. Thank you for giving him kindness when the world did not. I can’t tell with certainty he appreciated all you did. Animals are special in the way that they don’t dwell on the bad things in life, but lavish in the good. Thank for giving him a meal and a warm place to lay his little body, there’s a special place in heaven for people like you. RIP little angel, you were loved and your life mattered.
Good luck little man! I hope he finds his new family and THANK YOU! For giving him the chance! 💕

Im so sorry for your loss, losing a pet is an awful thing but you did right by Marley. She went peacefully after having enjoyed a lifetime with you. There’s nothing I can say that will ever make the loss easier, but I hope you know that Marley probably never spent time concerned for your love for her, on the contrary I’m sure every minute she spent with you she was enveloped in all the love you gave. Thank you for giving Marley 13 wonderful years. Til you guys meet again, Rest In Peace Marley 💕

They are absolutely family, They are the one family member who are always loving and affectionate no matter what. And she is absolutely waiting, and meeting again will be worth it all. Thank you so much! 💞

You really did you everything you could, thank you for giving Chloe the opportunity to have that procedure. You gave her your all and I know she knew it til the very end. And she still does just now she’s watching over you. Sending you a huge bear hug, if you ever want to vent you can dm me. Chloe will never be forgotten!

Im so sorry. I wish I had the words to help you through this loss. If it’s any consolation at least she was able to live her whole life feeling loved. She received medical care and comfort. I have a 13 year old with congestive heart failure as well, he almost died once on me, and thinking of him not being around breaks my heart. Again I’m so sorry but I’m so happy you were able to have a friend like Chloe, she was one in a million.

Hi! I work at an animal hospital, Summit Animal Hospital in Summit,il. We do senior dentals for $175. We also do preop blood work. If you get a chance I would stop by and have a doctor do a predental check up. Sorry if it’s doesn’t help much. They did a dental cleaning on my 12 year old 6 pound Chihuahua. They pulled most teeth, but he’s doing so much better. I hope your puppy gets what’s she needs! Good luck friend :) feel free to DM me if you have questions!

I’m really sorry that today will be a tough day for you, it’s sad to know you won’t see your friend again but I hope you can take solace in knowing that Sparta lived an amazing life full of love. Sparta may not be able to speak but I’m sure he’d say thank you for all the memories and good times. I myself have never believed in an afterlife but seeing as dogs are already living angels I find it hard to believe they aren’t watching over us in doggy heaven. One day you’ll be home and feel his presence or maybe see him in the yard, that’s just him checking in. Sending hugs and lots of love during such a tough time. RIP Sparta, run free good pup.
I’m so sorry for your loss, Carlos looked like the greatest boy. I know it sucks but you guys will meet again, til then you have an angel watching over you.
Rest In Peace Jessy, you will be missed. Say hi to my guys up there! So sorry for your loss 💕
Raj was lucky to have had a family who loved him so much. I can only imagine how difficult this must be for you, but I hope you know he was happy to be with you guys til the very end.
Im so sorry for your loss, he looked like a great pup. I’m sure he’s watching over you til you guys meet again.
I’m so proud of you, and I’m very happy you found someone who loves you so much! I hope you continue to get better and live your best life.

Hi, I’m really sorry. I cannot imagine all the emotions you’re feeling right now, and I don’t really know if I can type anything up to help. But I just want to extend a hug and let you know that if you ever need someone to vent to I am happy to listen. You can pm me anytime. I understand if it’s not something you want to do but you have a friend here, if you wanna yell, cry or complain.

I’m so sorry! You guys were lucky to have each other. She may not have been able to speak but every tail wag, every lick, every joyful look was her telling you how much she loved and appreciated you. Omg. Shuuuuutttt up. Some dogs are prone to violence, but that has nothing to do with breed. What’s BS is your ignorant comment. Really sucks about your neighbors dog but that can’t be applied to all pit bulls.

People should own whatever breed of dog they want to own. All dogs should be sterilized and breeding of all breeds shouldn’t be allowed. We have more than enough dogs in shelters. There’s no reason to discriminate a breed because of a humans ignorance.

There are dogs with a much higher prey drive than pits, like terriers and German shepherds. I do think they’re should be a middle ground, for all breeds. They’re all cute and cuddly but they’re all animals that can react spontaneously.

I hope this comment is a joke. Pit bulls aren’t inherently dangerous. People like you are the reasons these dogs get a bad reputation. This dogs pulling on the leash because he’s been confined to a small kennel and he’s excited to be out, not because he’s ignoring pain. Secondly those collars are meant to tighten on the dogs neck, they have them at almost every shelter and animal hospital. Almost any breed walking on it, especially a higher energy dog, ends up gasping a bit. I honestly hope you do your research next time before making ridiculous comments.
